root_cause_hypothesis: The system could not route the invoice as the corresponding Goods Receipt Note (GRN) has not been confirmed in the system. This prevents the required 3-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) from completing.
recommended_action: Contact the PO requestor to confirm receipt of goods/services and instruct them to create the GRN.
communication_draft:
Dear ABC Office Supplies,

We are writing in reference to your invoice #1 for $1250.00, associated with our purchase order PO-45001.

Our records indicate a discrepancy, as we have not yet registered a Goods Received Note (GRN) for this order. As per our internal process, payment cannot be released until we have confirmation that the goods have been received by our business.

To resolve this, please provide us with a signed Proof of Delivery (POD) confirming the delivery of these items. If the goods have not yet been delivered, please issue a credit note for this invoice.

We kindly request a response within 5 business days to avoid any further payment delays.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Kind regards,

Accounts Payable Team
